nativeBaseline: N2 frozen job79217516, strict checkMesh FAIL3 (D1086/W110/R2), not changed or rerun by this audit.
scope: Pure NumPy/SciPy offline candidate generation from original face planes, complete existing written children and same-rank exterior stencil. No new dependency in product, no source STL/old point movement, no full-case acceptance.
timingsScope: Seconds are CPU offline search only; they are not mesh-generation/API/deadline evidence.
validation: 16 tests pass, including actual original and perturbed SF/CC/V/D/W/R/S/N vs complete evaluator, unsupported coupled refusal, exact fixed faces/outside CC/V, complete geometry+five-Pareto saved candidates, height-bound exclusion, and rigorous fixed-triangle upper bounds on all 14 qualified actual bad tetrahedra.
limitations: Bounded search failure does not prove an AP or topology impossible.
Near-boundary floating candidates only pass if complete actual formulas accept; solver status alone is never acceptance.
Only same-rank outside state is covered; unsupported coupled stencils are refused.
Context point clearance is local; native all-point clearance, full coupled topology, complete stock checker and 300s deadline remain mandatory.
First search outputs are retained: revised geometry-derived kernel seed and generic fractional blends replace no physical coordinates; one-ULP determinant changes are not called improvement.
Preservation audit was added after the saved search results; it is independently recomputed from the same retained candidate, without modifying the original output bytes.

fixedBaseNecessaryBoundSummary.scope: Actual selected three-side/all-four branch and fixed triangular base only. Upper bounds above the threshold do not establish original-parent feasibility.
